data.title: BAYSTATE HEALTH ANNOUNCES PARTICIPATION IN NATIONAL CLINICAL TRIAL FOR ADVANCED BRAIN ANEURYSM TREATMENT
data.description: Springfield-based Baystate Health revealed today its selection to partake in a pioneering national clinical trial for Advanced Brain Aneurysm treatment. The hospital enrolled the first patients in the country for this trial. This significant development was made public on September 25, 2026.

data.title: The Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT) Announces 'FIT Future//Forward Conversations,' A Series of Live Talks with the Individuals Shaping the Global Creative Industries
data.description: In a recent update on September 25, 2026, the Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT) disclosed new public programming as part of FIT Future//Forward. This initiative was introduced by FIT President in alignment with the State University of New York (SUNY). FIT, renowned for providing creative education on a global scale, unveiled these latest offerings to enhance its strategic approach.

data.title: Overlord Labs Closes Oversubscribed Seed Financing, Bringing Total Funding to $10 Million to Advance Battery Intelligence for Edge AI Devices
data.description: A Silicon Valley-based company, Overlord Labs, Inc., revealed today the successful completion of its Seed financing round, which exceeded the initial target amount. The company specializes in developing advanced battery intelligence technology for demanding, battery-operated devices. This funding round marks a significant milestone for the company, as it brings the total amount raised to date to an impressive figure.

data.title: Former RESTORE Council Chief Scientist Appointed to Federal Hunting and Conservation Advisory Council
data.description: Renowned scientist Dr. Robert "Robbie" Kröger, known for his expertise in federal restoration science and global wildlife conservation, has been selected for a prominent national advisory position in Washington. The founder and executive director of The Origins Foundation, Dr. Kröger brings a wealth of experience to his new role. The appointment was announced on September 25, 2026.

data.title: NJASAP Applauds Senate for Passage of Aeromedical Reform Measures
data.description: In Columbus, Ohio on September 25, 2026, the NetJets Association of Shared Aircraft Pilots (NJASAP) urged the House to show support for the professional pilot community by passing companion legislation. The pilot union commended the U.S. Senate for passing S. 3257, the John A. Act, highlighting the importance of this legislation.

data.title: Brian and Chris O'Keefe of BrightStar Care Named Franchisee of the Year by International Franchise Association
data.description: A duo of franchise owners from Northern California, Brian and Chris O'Keefe, have been acknowledged in Chicago on September 25, 2026, for exemplifying leadership, generosity, and a community-focused ethos that epitomizes the essence of franchising. The O'Keefe brothers, who operate multiple units of BrightStar Care in the region, were recognized for their outstanding contributions to the franchise industry.

data.title: Infrasense Completes 3D Ground Penetrating Radar Investigation Along State Route 133 in Lowell, Massachusetts
data.description: In Lowell, Massachusetts, a recent 3D Ground Penetrating Radar (3D-GPR) investigation was conducted by the Infrasense team along around 1.37 miles of pavement on Route 133. The study covered both the westbound and eastbound travel lanes in the historic area.

data.title: Everlight Solar Resolves Nebraska Attorney General Matter
data.description: In Omaha, Nebraska on September 25, 2026, Everlight Solar finalized a settlement with the Nebraska Attorney General's Office concerning a lawsuit centered on collegiate sponsorship and marketing activities within the state. Everlight contends that the allegations raised in this legal battle lack merit. The agreement signifies a resolution to the dispute surrounding this matter.

data.title: Powering Community Resilience, Bloom Energy Supports First Responders in State College during ESPN College Campus Tour
data.description: In State College, Pennsylvania, Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) extended its sponsorship with ESPN Radio’s College Campus Tour powered by Bloom with a $10,000 donation to Alpha Fire Company. The contribution was presented before the Penn State-Wisconsin game to show support for the all-volunteer department established in 1899. The funds aim to assist the firefighters, first responders, and public servants dedicated to safeguarding the State College community.

data.title: Chase Launches Data Security Center to Help Customers Manage Connected Apps and Third-Party Data Sharing
data.description: Recently in New York, Chase launched its Data Security Center in a gradual release, aiding customers in comprehending and controlling the sharing of their financial data with external applications. The initiative aims to enhance transparency and effectiveness in data sharing, empowering customers to track and manage where their data is transmitted. This enables informed choices regarding connected apps and the ability to retain control over such connections.
